title: VTC Badges — Wall — Show — payload
description: A member's badge wall as a viewer sees it, answered only where the directory shows the viewer that member's card and the member shows their badges. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

entryId.description: The member whose wall to read. The caller's own entry reads their own wall.

Response.title: VTC Badges — Wall — Show — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/wall/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/wall/show/0.1#response.

entries.description: The badges the member holds and shows: pinned first, then in the member's own order (VTI-BDG-032). Hidden badges are never here (VTI-BDG-030).

visibility.description: The member's own setting (VTI-BDG-031). A viewer who is not the member only ever sees `members`.

kudosTotal.description: The member's kudos total: accepted, not hidden kudos awards (VTI-BDG-043). Present exactly when the community's badge settings have `showKudosTotals` true; absent otherwise, never zero in its place.
